items.fromString:
*Type of Issue*
Clarification / spec question — not a defect against the build.

*Context*
There's a mismatch between the PRD, the design, and the build on where the filter bar sits, and a test case has waived it without the PRD being updated.

*Observed*

* *Build (QA branch, desktop):* the five filter chips sit on the *same row as the tabs* (All / Estimates / Completed / My Work Orders).
* *PRD S1-R1 (v1.6, current):* "The filter bar is displayed *below the tab navigation row*… by default."
* *Claude design:* shows the filter chips on their *own row below* the tabs.
* *Test case C29557 / T1762290:* carries a note — _"Known and accepted: on the build tested the filter buttons sit on the same row as the tabs instead of on their own row below them. The product behaves this way on purpose for now."_

*The Gap*
The "same row for now" decision lives *only in the test case*. The PRD (source of truth) and the design both still say "below." Nothing in S1-R1 or the Key Decisions records the same-row layout as an accepted interim state, so the spec and the build currently disagree.

*Questions*

# Is the same-row layout an approved interim decision, or should the build be corrected to place the filter bar below the tabs (per S1-R1 and the design)?
# If it's approved (even temporarily), please update *S1-R1* (and/or Key Decisions) so the PRD reflects it — otherwise the requirement, the design, and the test case remain inconsistent.

*Reference*

* PRD Filters v1.6 (https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/shopviewapp/pages/572030978/Filters) — S1-R1; §4 Key Decisions
* Design: Claude design (filter bar below tabs)
* Test case: C29557 (S1-R1) — currently passing via a "known and accepted" note
